title: Redundant connection
statementMd:
A tree with `n` nodes (1..n) had one extra edge added. Return the edge that, when removed, leaves a tree; if several qualify return the one appearing last in `edges`.

**Example:** `redundant_connection([[1, 2], [1, 3], [2, 3]])` returns `[2, 3]`.
hints: Union-find: the edge that closes a cycle when processed in order.
